row_schema_example.user: 請用一至兩句繁體中文描述這張照片的主要內容。
row_schema_example.answer: 白色天鵝造型花盆放在黑色金屬架上，周圍有草和落葉。

references.official_description: An outdoor medium close-up of a white swan planter with small grass growth is sitting on top of a black iron platform with four legs. Under the iron planter holder is a rusted metal manhole cover. The swan is facing left with its head turned backwards and arched over towards its left wing. A sheet of tall, rusty metal is wrapped around the manhole cover and extends towards the upper left, containing the grassy area behind the planter. Brown leaves are scattered over the grassy area and gather at the bottom right, where a patch of red gravel meets a concrete walkway. Daytime.

references.rubric: Describe only visible primary subjects and relations; synonyms accepted; do not require exact wording or invent facts outside the image.

source.label_kind: AI-authored Traditional-Chinese adaptation; original English caption human-authored

image_review.method: actual view_image of raw downloaded JPEG during source research

source.modifications: Subset and publisher thumbnail; concise Traditional-Chinese QA adapted from human English caption and verified visible pixels.

rules: Each training photograph needs /scene plus /fact1 (unique IDs). Each held-out photograph needs /scene + /fact1 + /fact2.
Keep metadata family, split, image, cluster and source pins unchanged. task remains scene for all photo QA; qa_type records scene/object/attribute/action/relation/count/uncertainty.
Use natural Traditional-Chinese question and brief visibly supported answer; scene target 1-2 sentences. Do not use hidden geography, identities, intentions, flavors or implicit events.

support_sentences must be exact original full-caption substrings; retain official_description full and unmodified. If question is a visual uncertainty prompt, explicitly state visible-only justification separately.

Only image-viewed-and-full-caption-read after actual view_image of raw JPEG or real rendered Chromium image gallery plus reading full caption. Record gallery path/SHA, viewed IDs and method; preserve screenshots locally for follow-up validation.
Otherwise review_status translation-only-caption-read and image_review null. No claim human Chinese annotation or foundation-model-independent test.
Output UTF-8 JSONL one row per line, own assigned shards only.
final_gold_freeze: Coordinator will freeze full held-out gold/rubric SHA before inference; this row field is actual author timing, not a made-up freeze receipt.
